verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI document is downloadable at librechat.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key), so the core story is delivered. The GitHub README separately documents a programmatic Agent Management API (beta) that such a spec would plausibly describe, though no evidence links the two. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec and which API surface it covers, confirmation that the spec covers the Agent Management API, independent or hands-on corroboration of spec completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
